method: Latest 50 consecutive finalized sessions before record time, at least 300 seconds after close. SMA20 strictly above SMA50 permits a long open-to-close round trip in the next frozen session. Lunar arm additionally requires Moon-minus-Sun angle within 12 degrees of new/full at that session open. Equality is cash. No shorts or leverage.
sessionPolicy: Freeze provider-aligned dated opens/closes and next opens for the entire study plus 50 warmup sessions. Regular-session equities; FX feed-specific daily close including weekends and short sessions; crypto UTC. No inferred weekday calendar or forward-filled bar. Record and independent witness >=900 seconds before open. Settle >=300 seconds after close. Missed sessions remain visible, no backfill.
adjustmentPolicy: Unadjusted execution prices. Splits and other price-unit-changing corporate actions reset SMA warmup; no cross-action features or retroactive future adjustments. Intraday round trips hold no dividend entitlement. ETF distributions reset features only when provider policy declares a price-unit break; policy must be fixed before activation.
futuresPolicy: Excluded from this v3 candidate set. Commodity and index exposure uses explicitly named cash ETFs; continuous indexes and futures series cannot be substituted. Individual futures require a new protocol with contract expiry, margin and a predetermined roll schedule.
primaryMetric: Terminal net return difference (TA+lunar minus TA-only), per frozen asset in its native quote currency, at fixed window end.
inference: Descriptive pilot. No pooled independent-asset sample, significance tests, winner selection or predictive-benefit claims. Show every asset and all five families; within-family median differences are descriptive only, no currency pooling. Correlated assets remain correlated. A future confirmatory protocol must predeclare clustered inference and Holm familywise correction before fresh data; no reuse of this window as untouched holdout.
prerequisites: Written rights covering each provider, venue, public display, JSON delivery, caching, retained research and aggregate publication
Secure credentials and independently reviewed symbol/currency/tick/lot mappings
Dated eligibility and measured liquidity receipts for fixed inclusion set
Fresh future start/end dates after all acceptance checks
Independent timestamp access, private automation and verified complete offline restore
